test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ski (CounterID UInt32, EventDate Date, UserID UInt64, EventTime DateTime, URL String, Title String) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 8 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 10
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ski SELECT CounterID, EventDate, UserID, EventTime, URL, Title FROM hits_100m_single WHERE intHash64(WatchID) % 10 < 3 SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 16, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
ALTER TABLE ski MODIFY SETTING lock_acquire_timeout_for_background_operations = 600
OPTIMIZE TABLE ski FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1, optimize_skip_merged_partitions = 1

ALTER TABLE ski ADD INDEX idx_url_ngram URL TYPE ngrambf_v1(4, 32768, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 1, ADD INDEX idx_url_token URL TYPE tokenbf_v1(32768, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 1, ADD INDEX idx_url_bloom URL TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1, ADD INDEX idx_url_text URL TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha'), ADD INDEX idx_title_text Title TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha')
ALTER TABLE ski MATERIALIZE INDEX idx_url_ngram
ALTER TABLE ski MATERIALIZE INDEX idx_url_token
ALTER TABLE ski MATERIALIZE INDEX idx_url_bloom
ALTER TABLE ski MATERIALIZE INDEX idx_url_text
ALTER TABLE ski MATERIALIZE INDEX idx_title_text

SELECT throwIf(count() != 5 OR min(data_compressed_bytes) = 0) FROM system.data_skipping_indices WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'ski'

SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS query_log

SELECT throwIf(count() != 9 OR countIf(if(q <= 8, m != need, m > need + (total - need) / 4)) != 0, 'a tagged index query is missing in query_log, or it selected other granules than hold a match (text) or too many (bloom filters)') FROM ( SELECT toUInt8(substring(log_comment, 23)) AS q, ProfileEvents['SelectedMarks'] AS m FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment LIKE 'skip_index_text_hits.q%' AND event_time >= (SELECT metadata_modification_time FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'default' AND name = 'ski') ) AS l INNER JOIN ( SELECT t.1 AS q, t.2 AS need, t.3 * n AS total FROM ( SELECT count() AS n, countIf(yandex) AS yandex, countIf(like_yandex) AS like_yandex, countIf(like_google) AS like_google, countIf(google) AS google, countIf(youtube) AS youtube, countIf(facebook) AS facebook, countIf(any_tokens) AS any_tokens, countIf(msa) AS msa, countIf(in_list) AS in_list, countIf(komme) AS komme, countIf(kupit) AS kupit, countIf(all_tokens) AS all_tokens FROM ( SELECT max(hasToken(URL, 'yandex')) AS yandex, max(URL LIKE '%yandex%') AS like_yandex, max(URL LIKE '%google%') AS like_google, max(hasToken(URL, 'google')) AS google, max(hasToken(URL, 'youtube')) AS youtube, max(hasToken(URL, 'facebook')) AS facebook, max(hasAnyTokens(URL, ['google', 'zqxjkvwy', 'wikipedia'])) AS any_tokens, max(multiSearchAny(URL, ['google', 'zqxjkvwy', 'wikipedia'])) AS msa, max(URL IN ('http://komme%2F27.0.1453.116', 'http://irr.ru/index.php?showalbum/login-leniya7777294,938303130', 'http://no.such.host/zqxjkvwy')) AS in_list, max(URL = 'http://komme%2F27.0.1453.116') AS komme, max(hasToken(Title, 'купить')) AS kupit, max(hasAllTokens(Title, ['купить', 'Холодильник'])) AS all_tokens FROM ski GROUP BY _part, intDiv(_part_offset, 8192) ) ) ARRAY JOIN [(5, yandex, 1), (6, like_google, 1), (7, kupit, 1), (8, google + youtube + facebook + any_tokens + all_tokens, 7), (9, google, 1), (10, like_yandex, 1), (11, like_google, 1), (12, msa, 1), (13, komme + in_list, 10)] AS t ) AS d USING q SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = 0
